beginner.title: Get started with Booking.com
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Booking.com, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up your business
beginner.outcome: You can: configure Booking.com for your business
beginner.practice: Set up your profile and three services or products

beginner.title: Daily operations
beginner.outcome: You can: run day-to-day work in Booking.com
beginner.practice: Run one full day of operations in Booking.com

intermediate.title: Customers and data
intermediate.outcome: You can: keep clean customer and transaction records
intermediate.practice: Import or clean up your customer list

intermediate.title: Reports that matter
intermediate.outcome: You can: read the reports that guide decisions
intermediate.practice: Review last month's report and pick one action

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Booking.com
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Booking.com distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Booking.com
expert.outcome: You can: use Booking.com's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Scale and control
expert.outcome: You can: run Booking.com across a team or branches
expert.practice: Set up roles for staff and review the audit log

expert.title: Integrate Booking.com into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Booking.com with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Booking.com to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Booking.com well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Booking.com" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
